productionSpec.butter: Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite atlas for the referenced butter yellow baby seahorse. Preserve the large glossy eyes, rosy cheeks, tiny tubular snout, rounded crown bumps, translucent fin and thick spiral tail. Soft polished 3D plush-toy finish. Exactly 20 fully dressed whole-body characters in 5 columns and 4 rows. Same rest pose facing viewer-right, consistent identity and proportions, one complete outfit per cell, naturally fitted clothes AND accessories all integrated into each character. Never detached accessories or parts. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No text, labels, grid lines or floor shadows. Keep all hats and tails intact with transparent gutters. Row-major costumes: 1. blue denim overalls, round brown glasses, cream canvas satchel; 2. lilac star pajamas and matching floppy nightcap; 3. navy-white sailor shirt, white sailor cap with navy band and gold shell clasp; 4. pink knit pullover, oatmeal pompom beanie and pink scarf; 5. cream-peach scalloped tunic, peach bow and pearl necklace; 6. blue diving suit, goggles and short snorkel; 7. tan explorer vest, safari hat and brown satchel; 8. cream chef apron, white toque and red neckerchief; 9. yellow raincoat and rain hat, teal pouch; 10. mint artist smock, lavender beret, pencil in pocket; 11. sage green overalls, floral straw hat and flower pin; 12. navy star cape, wizard hat and moon pendant; 13. blue hero torso suit, red cape and gold star badge; 14. plum waistcoat, cream bowtie and pastel headphones; 15. teal zip jacket, cream visor and lavender short scarf; 16. ivory party shirt, peach bowtie and dotted cone hat; 17. cream velvet royal cape, rounded gold crown and pearls; 18. peach cardigan, flower headband and shell pendant; 19. cream bedtime shirt, lavender bonnet and pink neck ribbon; 20. red holiday coat with ivory trim, Santa cap and green bowtie.
